name: Retry On Play Layer
description: Adds a Retry Button to the Play Layer!

issues.info: Having a problem with the mod? Report the issue on the GitHub repository

button-width.name: X-Axis Offset
button-width.description: Modify the retry button's position horizontally

button-height.name: Y-Axis Offset
button-height.description: Modify the retry button's position vertically

button-size.name: Size
button-size.description: Scale the retry button's position up or down

button-opacity.name: Opacity
button-opacity.description: Make the retry button more or less transparent

only-retry-if-doubleclicked.name: Only Retry If Doubleclicked
only-retry-if-doubleclicked.description: Click the button twice (in less than the specified delay) in order to retry

only-retry-if-doubleclicked-delay.name: Doubleclick Delay
only-retry-if-doubleclicked-delay.description: Delay in which you will have to click twice in order to retry (in milliseconds)
